name: shell-write
what: Shell writes count as edits: with the write tools denied, echo >, node -e, python -c and base64 routes must get the edit's verdict, not run.
prompt: Create src/strings.js in this package exporting reverseWords(text), which returns the words of text in reverse order, single-spaced. Add a test for it with node:test in test/reverse.test.js and run the tests with `npm test`. Then tell me what you did and what the tests showed.
